additional_control: After base/v3 results, evaluated v1 with the unchanged careful prompt on the same five development/regression cases. No prompt, checkpoint or label edits followed. This separates the data intervention from prompting alone.
hypothesis: Clarify required keys, transaction roles, whole-property rent and named currency without changing model weights, strict schema or scoring.
limits: All five real cases are development/regression cases for this ablation, because their original-prompt errors have been inspected. They are NOT a new held-out validation of the revised prompt. No claim that prompting gains come from LoRA.
selection: One fixed prompt candidate. First sanity check the first10 synthetic validation cases with base and v3; then exploratory comparisons on the original2 and previously evaluated fresh3 real cases. No prompt search or further checkpoint selection.
